posts.title: Ramayana opens, and the season begins
posts.deck: Ramayana: Part 1 is in cinemas today with the second-biggest opening-day advance booking ever reported for a Bollywood film. KING follows on 24 December.

blocks.p: Diwali week, Thursday 5 November 2026. Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, produced by Namit Malhotra, with Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita, opened in cinemas this morning.

stats: Tickets sold before the first show

blocks.p: As reported by Sacnilk at 10:08 IST, that is the second-highest opening-day advance booking for a Bollywood film, behind Dhurandhar 2 (₹52.35 crore) and ahead of Jawan (₹40.75 crore). Koimoi reports it as the highest ever for a film that is not a sequel. These are reported pre-sales, not box office.

stats: still being counted; the final figure is due tomorrow

blocks.p: Live trackers were showing different day-one numbers through the morning, so we print N/A until a final figure is reported.

list: Hindustan Times: 4 stars (as reported by Marksmen Daily)

blocks.p: The common thread: the scale, the visual effects and Yash's Ravana are praised; the slow first half and the music divide the critics. Part 1 builds the world. The battle is saved for Part 2.

Ramayana's pre-sales passed Jawan's, as reported. The bar for a big Hindi opening has just been raised, 49 days before KING opens on 24 December. This season is a relay, not a clash: Ramayana at Diwali, KING at Christmas.
Watching both? Take the pledge on RAMAYANA to KING and play the six-round friendly fixture.

posts.title: RAMAYANA to KING: the release-day report
posts.deck: Every official YouTube video of both films, read at 12:40 IST on Ramayana's opening day. Two days ago they were level.

blocks.p: On 3 November the two films were level, with KING 324,348 views ahead. Since then KING's first song has pulled away: Tu Mil Jaaye alone added 10,732,163 views, more than four times what Ramayana's seven videos added together (2,356,467).

stats: RAMAYANA · Rise of a Legend, New Trailer
RAMAYANA · Rise of a Legend, Hindi (T-Series)
RAMAYANA · Sai Pallavi as Sita, Promo

blocks.p: Day three ran at about 319,000 views an hour. Day four is about 246,000: still climbing, at a steadier pace.

KING's two official teasers have 84,493,381 YouTube views together; the Avengers: Doomsday trailer has 83,931,977. KING's lead is 561,404, up from 515,054 yesterday. Not like-for-like: two videos against one, and KING has not released a trailer yet.
Not like-for-like either: seven videos against three, and a film on its release day against one 49 days away. The race that counts starts at the box office.
Read at 12:40 IST from each video's public YouTube page. 3 Nov figures: our report of 3 Nov, 21:15 IST.

blocks.h: What Agar Main King Hota is

blocks.p: Agar Main King Hota, if I were the King, is the question every Shah Rukh Khan fan has asked at least once. This site is where the fans answer it: a fan-built world around KING, Shah Rukh Khan's film that opens on 24 December 2026. Not a campaign you watch; one you enter.

blocks.p: Everything here is made by fans, for fans, and every number is one we read ourselves. SRK DAILY is where we write it up, every day, until KING and beyond.
Shah Rukh Khan vs. the clock. Toss won by the King, elected to bat at midnight.

time: No balcony. The man who has waved from Mannat almost every birthday since 2007 sent a handwritten note instead, lit across the scaffolding of his own home: "Thank you all for your wishes and love. Sending mine right back to you all. Lots of love and a big hug."

First ball. KING's first song, Tu Mil Jaaye, drops on YouTube the minute he turns 61. Sachin-Jigar, Kumaar, Arijit Singh, Madhubanti Bagchi, and Ed Sheeran in a Hindi film song. Shah Rukh and Deepika on screen.
His own post: "Of Love and other Battles... This December, #LoveLikeAKing"

blocks.p: We read the YouTube counter every 10 minutes, all day.
His Instagram reel, same 22 hours 55 minutes: 1.3 million likes, 62,100 comments, 51,000 shares.

5,000+ fans in Mumbai (an SRK Universe fan-club estimate, via PTI). Police barricades 500 metres from his gate. Fans screening DDLJ, feeding an orphanage, running free health check-ups. The Burj Khalifa saying "WE LOVE YOU SRK". The Bandra-Worli Sea Link carrying his face the night before.

After skipping the balcony in 2024 and 2025, and with Mannat wrapped in scaffolding, he walked out anyway. White T-shirt, beanie, a platform built just for the moment. Waved. Bowed. Folded his hands. Opened his arms.
Late night, the party outside Mannat went on, and he came back out. Kisses blown, the signature pose, the street singing his name.
3 November, 17:26 IST, 41 hours 17 minutes in: 41,796,168 views and 500,181 likes. Half a million likes before the second sunset. By 21:15 IST: 43,451,423 views.
Day one ran at about 1.5 million views an hour. Day two settled at about 357,000 an hour, the normal second-day curve for a song that has already been everywhere.

The fans did the rest. In three days we counted 127 new YouTube videos about the song and the birthday (reactions, reviews, covers, remixes, AI versions) and 176 fan-made posts on Instagram and X, each checked by hand.

And the season's scoreboard moved too. KING's two official teasers together had 84,010,198 YouTube views, past the Avengers: Doomsday trailer's 83,646,111. Ramayana: Part 1 opens on 5 November; all seven of its official videos add up to 127,204,303 views. KING's three: 127,528,651. Dead level, 51 days before KING opens.

Hindustan Times, Bollywood Hungama and UNI report, from the makers' own numbers, that Tu Mil Jaaye became the most-watched Indian film song on YouTube in its first 24 hours: 36.3 million views and 430,000 likes, past Zinda Banda from Jawan (34.6 million, as reported). That is the makers' figure as carried by the press, not a post from @iamsrk or @redchilliesent.

Our own log agrees with it. We read the public YouTube counter every 10 minutes on his birthday: 35,243,482 views and 416,961 likes at 23:04 IST, 22 hours 55 minutes after release. UNI and DNA also report more than 60 million views across all digital platforms in a day; we only count YouTube.
On agarmainkinghota.com, the fans' own KING campaign, we publish KING's buzz in public every day against a fixed baseline. Real numbers only; if we can't read it, it says N/A.
